title: An INTEREST REFUND on a not-charged-off loan credits INTEREST_RECEIVABLE 4 (loan 5 L39: credit 0.19, debit 0.19)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry an INTEREST_REFUND posted on loan 5 (product LP2_ADV_CUSTOM_PMT_ALLOC_PROGRESSIVE_LOAN_SCHEDULE_HORIZONTAL, NOT charged off) on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits). The dispatch posts an interest refund through the SAME method as an interest-payment waiver (AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan.java:134-135, isInterestPaymentWaiver() || isInterestRefund()), and the seam request carries the portions, the charged-off flag and the slot->account mapping only. request.interest_payment_waiver_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back transaction id 39 (externalId L39, type loanTransactionType.interestRefund): interestPortion 0.19 -> "19", principal/fee/penalty/overpayment 0. The charged-off state is the read-back's top-level chargedOff false. accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_ADV_CUSTOM_PMT_ALLOC_PROGRESSIVE_LOAN_SCHEDULE_HORIZONTAL.json (sha256 53246a7b...ed15): loanPortfolio 7, receivable interest/fee/penalty 4, overpayment 16, interestOnLoan 9, incomeFromChargeOffInterest 17. expect.interest_payment_waiver_journal_legs transcribes the two L39 legs in id order from the sweep: JE 114 CREDIT account 4 0.19, JE 115 DEBIT account 9 0.19. THIS VECTOR GRADES: the interest-refund credit slot on a not-charged-off loan. It does NOT grade the charged-off branch. Nothing was computed: every portion, account and leg is read directly from the committed files; amounts are exact decimals parsed to integer minor units, never a float.
